action.description: create (with the streaming and post-processing settings), push audio, finish (flushes the last chunk), close (discard).

audio.description: The next piece of the live recording (push only, up to 30 s per push, ten minutes per session).

latency.description: The model card's streaming presets (input buffer latency): very_high 30.4 s (chunk 340, right context 40, FIFO 40, update 300), high 10.0 s (124, 1, 124, 124), low 1.04 s (6, 7, 188, 144), ultra_low 0.32 s (3, 1, 188, 144); speaker cache 188 in all. Lower latency costs some accuracy.

chunk_frames.description: CHUNK_SIZE in 80 ms frames; overrides the preset.

right_context_frames.description: RIGHT_CONTEXT: future 80 ms frames attached after each chunk; overrides the preset.

fifo_frames.description: FIFO_SIZE: previous 80 ms frames attached before each chunk; overrides the preset.

update_period_frames.description: UPDATE_PERIOD: frames moved from the FIFO into the speaker cache at a time; overrides the preset.

speaker_cache_frames.description: SPEAKER_CACHE_SIZE in 80 ms frames; overrides the preset (188).

onset.description: Activity probability above which a speaker's segment starts.

offset.description: Activity probability below which a speaker's segment ends.

min_duration_on.description: Drop segments shorter than this many seconds.

min_duration_off.description: Fill gaps shorter than this many seconds within a speaker.

include_probabilities.description: Also return each speaker's activity probability for every 80 ms frame.
